title: Engineer I, Mechanical Engineering
description:
**Job Summary:**

The **Mechanical Engineer, DC Power** develops the mechanical product design and system integration content within technical customer proposals for Vertiv's Modular Power Converters product line. This role works under the direction of the Project Proposals \& Global Engineering Lead, producing product design layouts with tolerance analysis, system assembly and integration documentation, connection/interface definitions, and manufacturing/assembly considerations. A key responsibility is ensuring proposed designs are buildable, properly toleranced, and aligned with customer requirements.


**Responsibilities:**

* Develop product design layout drawings for customer packages \- module arrangements, shelf configurations, and cabinet assemblies
* Perform tolerance stack\-up analysis to verify fit, form, and function across mating components and assemblies
* Define system assembly sequences and integration procedures for modular DC power configurations
* Document all mechanical connections and interfaces \- power bus, signal cable routing, cooling interfaces, grounding paths, and mating sequences
* Create site fit documentation \- physical footprint, clearance requirements, and interface dimensions with customer infrastructure
* Coordinate with DFM Engineer on manufacturability of proposed configurations and assembly processes
* Review project designs (mechanical) under Proposals Lead for accuracy to customer site expectations
* Verify requirements traceability \- ensure every customer mechanical requirement has a corresponding specification response
* Collaborate with team to ensure mechanical and electrical package content is consistent

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field
* 2\+ years of experience in mechanical product design, system integration, or product engineering
* Experience with product layout drawings, assembly documentation, and tolerance stack\-up analysis
* Proficiency in geometric dimensioning

**A Snapshot of Your Day**


The Senior Protection \& Control (P\&C) Commissioning Engineer will serve as the technical authority on\-site for protection and control commissioning activities supporting high\-voltage substation EPC and turnkey projects. You will develop and execute commissioning strategies, oversee testing of protection relays, control systems, SCADA interfaces, metering systems, and secondary equipment, and ensure systems are safely energized and integrated. * Lead and oversee testing and commissioning of protection relays, control systems, metering equipment, SCADA interfaces, communication systems, and substation control panels.

* Supervise, mentor, and provide technical direction to commissioning teams while ensuring adherence to safety, quality, and project requirements.
* Coordinate with project managers, OEMs, engineering teams, construction personnel, and client representatives to align commissioning activities with project timelines, budgets, and technical requirements.

description:

E Source is a research, data/analytics, and technology focused professional services firm focused exclusively on the Utility industry in North America. * Oversee the quality of power flow, voltage stability, transient stability, and short\-circuit analyses
* Conduct studies in areas such as generator and load interconnections, transmission planning, and economic analyses

title: Critical Environment Program Manager
description: Overview Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I Critical Environment Program Manager, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers trainings and opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications. Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter p rofessionals working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide. With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
